title: feat: add Azure FLUX 1.1 Pro image model
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `black-forest-labs/flux.1.1-pro` at 0.75× Azure retail price ($0.03/image), with East US primary and same-cost Sweden Central fallback.
- Pins existing Azure deployments to exact GA version `1` at 25 RPM per region; no endpoint routes or credentials changed.
- Validates model-specific dimensions, text-only input, seed forwarding, provider errors, and flat image usage. Updates OpenAPI parameter descriptions and effective-price snapshot.
- Tested: 30 focused Gen tests, Gen typecheck, Enter price snapshot, live authenticated East and forced-Sweden E2E (PNG, cache, 0.03 Pollen debit). Local content-safety service DNS is unavailable and its existing fail-open path was exercised.

Quest-accessible (paid by Azure credit). GA with no scheduled retirement. Both regions re-checked live on 2026-09-23.

gist.headline: A new flux blooms
gist.blurb: Azure FLUX 1.1 Pro has landed in the image garden. It makes polished images at 0.03 Pollen each, with a second region quietly standing by in case the first one needs a cup of tea.
gist.summary: Added Azure-hosted `black-forest-labs/flux.1.1-pro` image generation at $0.03 per image (0.03 Pollen), with East US as primary, Sweden Central fallback, exact GA version `1`, and model-specific dimension, text-only, seed, error, and usage handling.
gist.impact: Builders can now generate with FLUX 1.1 Pro through the existing image API, receiving seed-aware PNG results with automatic same-price regional fallback and a flat 0.03 Pollen debit per image.
gist.visual_concept: Depict FLUX 1.1 Pro as a luminous flower-powered image printer in a cozy garden workshop: a primary East US bloom feeds the printer while a Sweden Central bloom is connected as a friendly backup vine. Polli, wearing tiny painter goggles and holding a seed packet, inspects a crisp generated landscape emerging from the printer; a small CRT robot can watch the two-region signal lights.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene in a warm garden workshop where Polli, the cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings, wears tiny painter goggles and plants a seed beside a flower-powered image printer. The printer produces a beautiful pixel landscape from a glowing lime green (#ecf874) FLUX 1.1 Pro flower, while a second pastel Sweden bloom connects by a backup vine; a cute CRT-monitor robot watches two happy region lights, with subtle pixel-font text reading “FLUX 1.1 PRO”. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nature-filled code plants, dark purple (#110518) outlines, nostalgic but beautiful.
